scripts.build:cf: npx opennextjs-cloudflare build --dangerouslyUseUnsupportedNextVersion && cp -r .open-next/cloudflare .open-next/assets/ && cp -r .open-next/middleware .open-next/assets/ && cp -r .open-next/server-functions .open-next/assets/ && cp -r .open-next/.build .open-next/assets/ && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const f='.open-next/assets/_routes.json';const r=fs.existsSync(f)?JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8')):{version:1,include:['/*'],exclude:[]};if(!r.exclude.includes('/_next/static/*'))r.exclude.unshift('/_next/static/*');fs.writeFileSync(f,JSON.stringify(r,null,2));console.log('_routes.json updated:',JSON.stringify(r));"
scripts.deploy: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=https://ventastecate.com npx opennextjs-cloudflare build --dangerouslyUseUnsupportedNextVersion && npx opennextjs-cloudflare deploy
